variants.headline: Looking back: full shelves, empty household purses
variants.sub: Households are hungry despite available food because they do not have the money to buy it.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: Food was for sale, but households cannot afford it and were going hungry beside full shelves.

Inventory and purchasing power are separate sides of a transaction. This report concerns the buyer's inability to pay despite goods being available. A sound commercial assessment should keep that distinction visible and avoid treating unsatisfied need as though it automatically establishes a physical shortage of the product itself.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We criticise {target} on the standard of access to necessities. Food for sale is not an adequate answer to households that cannot afford it, and stewardship deserves judgment from the hungry person's position.

variants.sub: There is food on the shelves, but people without enough money cannot obtain their meals.

variants.headline: Looking back: hunger beside food that cannot be afforded
variants.sub: Food is for sale, but households cannot afford it and are going hungry beside full shelves.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to our earlier coverage. Our original account recorded this: There was food on the shelves, but people without enough money cannot obtain their meals.

Inventory and purchasing power are separate sides of a transaction. This report concerns the buyer's inability to pay despite goods being available. A sound commercial assessment should keep that distinction visible and avoid treating unsatisfied need as though it automatically establishes a physical shortage of the product itself.

Changes since then deserve examination against the original record. The need to distinguish an established event from its associated hopes and fears remains.

We criticise {target} on the standard of access to necessities. Food for sale is not an adequate answer to households that cannot afford it, and stewardship deserves judgment from the hungry person's position.
